recipes.name: Fully Stuffed Omelette (Cutting)
instructions: Chop 5 oz of Chicken Breast and season with Paprika, Salt, and Pepper (or your preferred seasoning). Slice 1/4 of an Avocado into equal pieces. Slice 1/2 of a Bell Pepper into equal pieces. Slice 1/2 of a Tomato into equal pieces. Heat one pan over high heat and another over medium heat. Apply nonstick cooking spray to both pans.
Mix 50 g of Fat-Free Greek Yogurt, 25 g of Ketchup, and 0-5 g of Sriracha into a bowl until evenly combined.

Lay 2 strips of Turkey Bacon in the hot pan until crisp on both sides, then remove. Once the Bacon is cooked, sear the chicken breast on both sides, then continue cooking, turning as needed, until evenly cooked. Check if the Chicken Breast is fully cooked by cutting through a few pieces with the spatula and making sure the insides are entirely white.
Evenly pour 200 g of Egg Whites onto the medium heat pan and sprinkle salt and pepper. Cook until the eggs are set on top.

Once the egg base is fully cooked, add to half the base: The Chicken, then the Turkey Bacon, then 1 cup of Spinach, the Tomato, the Avocado, the Bell Pepper, 30 g of Low-Fat Cheese, and the high-protein breakfast sauce. Fold the empty half over the filling.
Plate and garnish.

Evenly pour the egg mixture onto the medium heat pan and sprinkle salt and pepper. Cook until the eggs are set on top.

Once the egg base is fully cooked, add to half the base: The Chicken, then the Turkey Bacon, then 2 cups of Spinach, the Tomato, the Avocado, the Bell Pepper, 150 g of Low-Fat Cheese, and the high-protein breakfast sauce. Fold the empty half over the filling.
Plate and garnish.

recipes.name: Beef and Potato Scramble (Cutting)
instructions: Either Chop 8 oz of Sweet/Regular Potatoes or Use a bag of pre-chopped or pre-shredded potatoes and measure out 8 oz. Season 6 oz of 95% Lean Ground Beef with Salt and Pepper. Slice 1 whole Green Onion Dice 1/4 of an Onion Slice 1/2 of a Bell Pepper into equal pieces Slice 2 strips of Turkey Bacon into bits Heat one pot on medium-high heat. Apply nonstick cooking spray to the pot.

Toss everything except the Egg Whites and Green Onions into a pot and keep stirring on medium-high until everything is cooked. Everything else should be cooked when the bacon is cooked. Add 200 g of Egg Whites and the Green Onions on top of the Mash and cover with a lid until the eggs are cooked through.

Start with crisping both sides of the bacon in the bottom of the pot. Add the beef and potatoes onto the bacon and keep chopping with your spatula until fully cooked. Add the diced Onions and chopped Bell Peppers and cover with a lid until half cooked. Remove the lid and add the Egg Whites and Green Onions on the top. Cover with the lid again until the Egg Whites are fully cooked.
Eat straight out of the pot for maximum Alpha-ness. Plate and garnish.

recipes.name: Creamy Souffle (Cutting)
instructions: Chop 6 oz of Chicken Breast and season with Paprika, Salt, and Pepper (or your preferred seasoning). Slice 1/4 of an Avocado into equal pieces. Optional: Chop 1/2 of a Green Onion Separate the yolks and whites from 2 whole Eggs Whisk yolks with a Pinch of Salt until combined Add some optional: Zero Calorie Sweetener to the whites and whisk until stiff peaks form. (Warning: Do not, under any circumstance, manually use a whisk. It takes over 30 minutes of torture. Use an electric whisker.) Heat one pan over high heat and another over medium heat. Apply nonstick cooking spray to both pans.

Sear the chicken breast on both sides, then continue cooking, turning as needed, until evenly cooked. Check if the Chicken Breast is fully cooked by cutting through a few pieces with the spatula and making sure the insides are fully white.

Evenly pour the egg yolk mixture into the medium heat pan into a circular shape and immediately gently lay the fluffy egg whites on top of the yolks when they begin to cook. Cover with a lid and wait until the yolks are fully formed at the bottom.
Gently place the Avocado onto the plate, followed by the chicken, followed by the optional chopped green onion, and finished off with the souffle base. Plate and garnish.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito (Cutting)
instructions: Mix in a bowl until evenly combined: 6 oz of Chicken, 25 g of Fat-Free Greek Yogurt, 15 g of your favorite Ketchup, 5-10 g of Sriracha, 3 g of Paprika, 3 g of Lemon Juice, 3 g of Garlic Powder Slice 1/4 of an Avocado Slice 1/4 of a Bell Pepper Slice 1/4 of an Onion Dice 1 strip of Bacon Dice Garlic to taste. Dice Tomato to taste. Chop Lettuce to taste. Heat one pan over high heat and another over medium-high heat. Apply nonstick cooking spray to both pans.
Rinse the rice 2-3 times, until the water runs clear. Add equal volumes of rice and water to the rice cooker and cook.

Load the high heat pan with your Chipotle Meat Marinade and sear one side before turning the heat down to medium and stirring the meat to create an even cook. Check if the meat is cooked by cutting through pieces occasionally with your spatula.
Onto your medium-high heat pan add in this order: The Bacon until each piece is crispy. The Onions & Garlic until sauteed. 1/4 cup of Black Beans & the Bell Peppers until heated up.
Add to 1/2 cup of Cooked Rice in this order: 1/4 Zest of a Lime. 1/4 Zest of a Lemon. Cilantro to taste.

Add all of your created ingredients onto 1 whole Flour Tortilla in this order: The Cilantro Lime Rice. The Bacon Black Beans. The Chipotle Meat. The Avocado. The Tomato. The Lettuce. Wrap the burrito.
Plate and garnish.

Take 2/3 cup of cooked Sushi Rice (use sushi rice so the buns hold together) and tightly pack the rice together with wet hands (for zero stick-age) to form 2 cylindrical buns. Take your Rice Buns and Place them onto one of the pans and crisp both sides to keep the buns in the bun shape.

Place the Steak onto the pan and sear all sides on high heat. Continuously flip the Steak until all the insides are cooked properly. Steak is cooked to medium-rare when the insides are slightly red. Steak is cooked to medium-well when the insides are all browned.
OPTIONAL: FRYING THE EGGS
Crack 1 whole Egg into the center of the medium-heat pan and cover with a pot lid when the whites are halfway cooked to evenly cook the whole egg without running the risk of burning the bottom.
In this order, or however you want: First Rice Bun, Optional: Fried Egg, Tomato, Optional: 10 g of Japanese Kewpie Mayo, Teriyaki Beef, Lettuce, Rice Bun
Plate and garnish.

recipes.name: Chicken and Rice Bowl (Cutting)
instructions: Marinade a juicy 10 oz of Chicken Breast with: Zero Calorie Brown Sugar, Onion, Garlic Powder, Italiano Seasoning, Chicken Stock Powder, Pepper, Flour, Water Specific amounts are left out for each of the marinade ingredients because mama intended for this recipe to be completely up to you and however your taste buds Serve. recipes.name: Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl (Cutting)
instructions: Gently pat to dry 10 oz of Sushi Grade Ahi Tuna and dice into 1/2 in cubes. Mix into a large bowl: The Sushi Grade Ahi Tuna, 1.5 tbsp of Soy Sauce, 1/2 tsp of Sesame Oil, Thinly sliced 1/4 of an Onion, Thinly sliced 1 whole Green Onion, 1/2 tbsp of Zero Calorie Sweetener, Grated 1/2 tbsp of Ginger. Either let the Poke marinate for 2 hours or serve fresh.
OPTIONAL: MAKING THE RICE

Fill your rice cooker to about half-full with uncooked Sushi Rice. Place that amount of rice into a strainer within the rice cooker pot and use your hands to massage the rice until the water becomes a milky color, indicating the starch is being washed away. Dump out the starchy water and repeat this process 2-3 times until the water that is strained out becomes clear. Refill the rice cooker with the clean rice and add the same amount of water as rice (ex: 5 cups of rice + 5 cups of water.) into the pot, and cook in the rice cooker.

Layout as much Butter Lettuce as you want. (It doesn't matter how much because lettuce has basically zero calories.) Use the Lettuce as a healthy wrap alternative to gently cradle your delicious Poke. If you have extra calories in your diet, you may add 1 cup of cooked Rice to create a more traditional Poke profile. You may also choose to top you're Poke with: Optional: 1/4 of an Avocado Optional: 100 g of Pineapple Optional: The desired amount of chopped up Cucumber Optional: The desired amount of chopped up Sriracha Optional: The desired amount of Seaweed
Plate and garnish.
